definitions.explanation: Food prepared in the Japanese culinary tradition. A broad term encompassing everything from sushi and tempura to everyday home cooking.

examples.japanese: {日本食|にほんしょく}が{好|す}きですか。
{海外|かいがい}でも{日本食|にほんしょく}レストランが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Japanese restaurants are increasing overseas as well.

examples.japanese: {日本食|にほんしょく}は{栄養|えいよう}バランスが{良|よ}く、{健康的|けんこうてき}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Japanese food is said to be healthy with good nutritional balance.

notes:
USAGE:
A general term for Japanese cuisine. Interchangeable with {和食|わしょく} in most contexts, though {和食|わしょく} tends to emphasize traditional dishes while {日本食|にほんしょく} can include modern Japanese cooking. Often contrasted with {洋食|ようしょく} (Western food) or {中華|ちゅうか} (Chinese food).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本食|にほんしょく}レストラン: Japanese restaurant
- {日本食|にほんしょく}ブーム: Japanese food boom
- {日本食|にほんしょく}の{文化|ぶんか}: Japanese food culture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和食|わしょく}: Japanese cuisine (emphasizes traditional style)
- {洋食|ようしょく}: Western-style food
- {料理|りょうり}: cooking, cuisine (general)
